title: Minsk opposition protest and human chain against Belarus–Russia integration (historical event; page-date false positive)
reason: AFN body explicitly dates the matching action to 29 December 2019, outside this unit month. The AllPravda page carries a 15 June 2023 page timestamp but no event date; the identical headline and subject indicate this is a historical-republication lead, not evidence of a distinct June 2023 event.
notes: AFN reports 50–150 attendees in the 2019 episode and a live chain on Independence Avenue. Do not transfer that count/date to a 2023 episode. The AllPravda article alone does not establish any 2023 occurrence; source relationship is a strong title/content match but not formally documented.

title: Drogichin Baptists wait outside police station to welcome Burshtyn's release
reason: The source describes a welcoming crowd, not a public demand directed at the Belarusian state or state policy. The reported number is only 'more than 20' and does not establish 50 simultaneous participants.
notes: This is a separate June 2 gathering, not the May 27 street faith-sharing group and not a continuation of a qualifying MM protest. Reused only as a documented prior-unit cross-month body consultation; no new body request was made.
